articulation.label: usually
articulation.alt: usually: /j/ → /u/ → /ʒ/ → /u/ → /ə/ → /l/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /j/: Front tongue high; glide into the next vowel.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/ʒ/: Tongue blade behind the ridge; add voice.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
